name: 99 Herculis

paper.title: 99 Herculis: Host to a Circumbinary Polar-ring Debris Disk

notes: Eccentric-orbit binary hosting the only known polar-aligned circumbinary debris disk, resolved with Herschel PACS at 70/100/160um (Kennedy et al. 2012, arXiv:1201.1911). Disk position angle misaligned from the binary line of nodes, consistent with a near-polar configuration perpendicular to the binary pericenter direction.
